objective: Al terminar hablas de tus experiencias y de cuánto tiempo llevas haciendo algo, y eliges bien entre present perfect y pasado simple.

warmup.prompt_es: Checkpoint de la unidad 8: junta el present perfect con ever, never, just, already, yet, for y since.

input.recap_es: Repasa: have / has + participio, ever y never, just / already / yet, present perfect o pasado simple, y for / since.

md_es: - *I've seen · she hasn't eaten · Have you ever been to …? — Yes, I have.*
- *I've never flown. · once · twice · three times · the best … I've ever seen*
- *I've just finished · I've already packed · I haven't finished yet*
- *I've been to Rome. (¿cuándo? no importa) · I went in 2022. (tiempo terminado)*
- *How long have you lived here? — For five years. / Since 2020.*

exercises.prompt: I've never ___ (be) to Italy.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Participio de be: been.

exercises.prompt: She has ___ (eat) sushi twice.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Participio de eat: eaten.

exercises.prompt: ¿Qué es seguro?
options: He is going to meet Anna
They will go to the cinema
answer: He is going to meet Anna
exercises.audio_text: I'm going to meet Anna at six. We might go to the cinema, or we might have dinner. I'll call you later.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Dice 'I'm going to meet Anna at six'; lo demás es might.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Dice 'I'm going to meet Anna at six'; lo demás es might.

exercises.prompt: You can see a film at the ___.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Las películas se ven en el cinema.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Las películas se ven en el cinema.

exercises.prompt: I've ___ arrived. I'm at the door. (acabo de)

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Just = acabo de.

exercises.prompt: We haven't finished the project ___.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Yet al final de la negativa.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Yet al final de la negativa.

exercises.prompt: I've worked here ___ 2019.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Since + año.

exercises.prompt: I've lived in this house ___ ten years.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: For + periodo.

exercises.prompt: Une cada frase con su significado.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Son frases clave para comprar.

exercises.prompt: Elige la frase correcta.
options: I have seen her last week.
I have saw her last week.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Last week es tiempo terminado: pasado simple.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Last week es tiempo terminado: pasado simple.

exercises.prompt: ¿Qué hacen mañana?
exercises.audio_text: I'm meeting my friends tomorrow. We're going to the cinema.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Dice 'We're going to the cinema'.

exercises.prompt: Hay un error. Escribe la frase correcta.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Con since: present perfect.

exercises.prompt: Hay un error. Escribe la frase correcta.
answer: Where did you go on holiday?

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Falta did y el verbo va en base.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Falta did y el verbo va en base.

exercises.prompt: Hay un error. Escribe la frase correcta.
exercises.text: I have went to Paris twice.
answer: I have been to Paris twice.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Para visitas se usa been.

exercises.prompt: Hay un error. Escribe la frase correcta.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Can no lleva -s.

exercises.prompt: ¿Cuánto tiempo estuvo en Japón?
exercises.audio_text: I've been to Japan once. I went in 2019 and stayed for two weeks. I haven't been back yet, but I'd love to go again.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Dice 'stayed for two weeks'.

exercises.prompt: He vivido en esta ciudad durante diez años y nunca he estado en el museo.
answer: I've lived in this city for ten years and I've never been to the museum.
I have lived in this city for ten years and I have never been to the museum.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Present perfect con for y never.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Present perfect con for y never.

exercises.prompt: Escribe 5 frases sobre ti: dos experiencias (present perfect), algo que nunca has hecho, cuánto tiempo llevas en tu ciudad o trabajo (for / since) y un detalle en pasado simple.
self_check_es: ¿Usaste pasado simple con un tiempo terminado?
exercises.model_answer: I've visited Spain twice. I've never eaten snails. I've lived in this city for six years and I've worked here since 2021. I went to Madrid last year and I loved it.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Compara tu texto con el modelo y la lista de control.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Compara tu texto con el modelo y la lista de control.

exercises.situation_es: Un amigo te pregunta por tus viajes.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Have you ever been to another country?

turns.speaker: You
choices: Yes, I have. I've been to Spain twice. I went there last year.
Yes, I have went to Spain. I have gone last year.
turns.why_es: Present perfect + pasado simple para detalles.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: How long have you studied English?

turns.speaker: You
choices: I've studied it for three years.
I study it since three years.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Practica diciendo en voz alta tu parte.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Practica diciendo en voz alta tu parte.

answer: She isn't old enough to drive.

key_phrases: have / has + participio · Have you ever …?
never · once · twice · the best … I've ever …
for + periodo · since + momento · pasado simple + tiempo terminado
